packaging_note: Phase 01 retains its established QMB, pressure, oven PID monitoring, Keysight, Arduino, shutter, ramp, PID, watchdog and safety logic. It contains no 200 C oven PID startup write; that command remains specific to Phase 03. The 0.9.18 build keeps monitoring-only IMPAC IPE 140 acquisition on COM10, persistent material modes, pa-based emissivity verification, raw/sample logging and the display-only OVEN PID / PYROMETER / SAMPLE EST. selector. The selector is lifted above the dynamic graph title, and the presentation-only dashboard uses the complete right-side height and added width so Operator controls and its buttons remain separate and visible. Manual Keysight current text entry no longer submits on focus loss; only Set manual current sends the command. A topmost audible desktop alarm is raised when a valid Phase 01 pressure reading exceeds 5e-6 mbar. No editable experimental value, control decision, hard equipment limit or saved data path was removed or changed. The packaged resource is authoritative; the backup resource is the matching current recovery snapshot. Bugfix: the Manual I textbox no longer sends on focus loss; only Set manual current sends. Added a topmost audible desktop pressure alarm above 5e-6 mbar with hysteresis and popup repeat protection. Performance maintenance: live plotting now uses bounded full-run sampling, less frequent autoscaling, and background complete-data saves so GUI mouse actions remain responsive during long runs. Experimental control, safety logic and complete saved data are unchanged. GUI correction: Oven PID, Pyrometer and Sample estimate now use matching red, blue and yellow/gold line/title/selector accents; the selector/title strip is positioned slightly lower. Graph-only snapshots are rendered by a dedicated background worker and the live plot is bounded to 400 points at a 0.50 s refresh to prevent snapshot rendering and redraw load from blocking mouse events. Project archive v15 / internal release 0.9.21 adds run-selectable temperature, rate and compound CK-1 feedback. Temperature remains the packaged default. Rate feedback uses a trimmed CK-1 QMB filter, conservative asymmetric PID current steps, anti-windup, stable in-band qualification, a stale-signal hard stop and a rate-control temperature ceiling. Compound mode progressively suppresses positive current corrections near that ceiling. The controller remains active through WAIT_SHUTTER_OPEN, CALIBRATION and WAIT_SHUTTER_CLOSE; existing hard current/voltage protections and the independent temperature watchdog remain authoritative.

packaging_note: Phase 02 retains direct verified COSCON UDP automation for Degas, target validation, Operate, measured-output qualification, continuous pressure/interlock/energy/emission supervision, automatic Standby, oven PID control, logging and safe-stop behavior. Version 0.9.17 removed ICN2 from the window title and reduced permanent visual density; these changes remain in 0.9.18. The main screen shows one Waiting / Ready / Check system result, while COSCON mode and the hardware interlock remain available inside Auxiliary diagnostics and continue to drive the unchanged automation, CSV log and safety logic. The active instruction, valid operator action, pressure, energy, emission, oven values and timing remain prominent. The established Phase 02 hard pressure emergency at 1e-4 mbar now also raises the same topmost audible desktop alarm; the lower 5e-6 threshold is intentionally not used here because normal argon sputtering is performed near 2e-5 mbar. No COSCON command, recipe value, pressure limit, PID behavior or manual leak-valve responsibility changed. The packaged resource is authoritative; the backup resource is the matching current recovery snapshot. Added the same topmost audible desktop alarm at the existing Phase 02 emergency threshold (1e-4 mbar), because the normal Ar sputtering target is intentionally around 2e-5 mbar. Safety and diagnostics update: isolated COSCON emission excursions are warned and rechecked, with safe abort only after a configurable number of consecutive out-of-tolerance reads. Launcher-editable energy/emission margins and recheck settings were added. Optional Energy Current, Anode Voltage and Repeller Voltage diagnostics are displayed/logged without affecting primary interlocks or abort logic. Version 0.9.19 adds the run-only Start without initial Degas workflow option for continuation of the same chamber preparation after a partial Phase 02 run. The option is disabled by default, requires an explicit preflight confirmation, is shown as skipped in the workflow dashboard, and is recorded in the effective run parameters. All pressure, COSCON mode, hardware interlock, energy, emission and safe-Standby protections remain active. Project archive v14 / internal release 0.9.20 changes the Phase 02 Abort / Safe Stop oven PID reset default from 20 C to 0 C in both the runtime configuration and launcher editor. COSCON safe-state handling, pressure/interlock supervision, Keysight monitoring and all other abort protections remain active.

Performance maintenance: live plotting now uses bounded full-run sampling, less frequent autoscaling, and background complete-data saves so GUI mouse actions remain responsive during long runs. Experimental control, safety logic and complete saved data are unchanged. GUI correction: Oven PID, Pyrometer and Sample estimate now use matching red, blue and yellow/gold line/title/selector accents; the selector/title strip is positioned slightly lower. Graph-only snapshots are rendered by a dedicated background worker and the live plot is bounded to 400 points at a 0.50 s refresh to prevent snapshot rendering and redraw load from blocking mouse events. Project archive v15 / internal release 0.9.21 adds the same selectable temperature, rate and compound CK-1 feedback used in Phase 01. Rate feedback stays active through WAIT_SHUTTER_OPEN, EVAPORATION and WAIT_SHUTTER_CLOSE, with trimmed filtering, asymmetric PID limits, anti-windup, stable-rate qualification, stale-signal safe stop and temperature supervision. The shutter-open measurement reset now clears only thickness histories and preserves continuous QMB rate data required by the feedback loop. The established thickness target, 200 C oven PID startup, normal Keysight-ON handoff and abort ramp-down behavior remain unchanged.

packaging_note: Phase 04 retains its established oven PID sequence, editable stage targets/holds, CK-1 Arduino monitor, Keysight ramp-down, switch-off confirmation, abort and failsafe behavior. The pyrometer features introduced before 0.9.18 remain active: monitoring-only IMPAC IPE 140 acquisition on COM10 (38400 baud, 8E1, address 00), the shared persistent launcher material mode, pa-based emissivity readback, verified four-digit UPP emissivity setup, and the OVEN PID / PYROMETER / SAMPLE EST. display selector. Telemetry and saved comparison plots include oven, raw pyrometer and estimated sample temperatures; below-cutoff estimates are retained with an extrapolation warning. Pyrometer data never changes PID setpoints, annealing transitions, Keysight control or safety decisions. Existing data routing, run-only annealing overrides and serial cleanup remain active. Unchanged by this bugfix because Phase 04 does not read the XGS600 chamber pressure. Project archive v14 / internal release 0.9.20 removes the obsolete final 30 C command. After the second hold, Phase 04 sends the cooldown target (0 C by default), holds that PID SV for 10 minutes, and finishes with the PID still at the cooldown target. Abort uses the same cooldown target before Keysight shutdown. The Phase sequence panel is positioned slightly lower and its text is shortened for legibility. The obsolete launcher Final PID target field was removed; older saved modes are migrated automatically.
